messages.subject: For Carsten Spohr | Global aviation, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Lufthansa Group Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Carsten Spohr, Chairman of the Executive Board and Chief Executive Officer.

Lufthansa Group's international aviation network operates across complex government, regulatory, airport and sustainability environments. That interface closely matches my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including coordination with aviation and other public authorities.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, aviation coordination and global stakeholder strategy might support Lufthansa Group's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Lufthansa Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
